hero.title: Welcome to Better Dagupan
hero.subtitle: The volunteer-run community portal for the City of Dagupan. Find information, access government services, and follow what the city government publishes.

services.title: Popular Services
services.description: Access official government services quickly and easily. Find what you need for citizenship, business, education, and more.

footer.copyright: Better Dagupan - Source code is covered by the repository license. Individual records and source materials retain the terms of the body that published them.

joinUs.stripSubtitle: Help build the future of the Philippines and governance through technology
joinUs.bannerSubtitle: Help build the future of the Philippines and governance through technology.

data.title: Real-Time Data Services
data.description: Access up-to-date information on weather conditions and foreign exchange rates across the Philippines.
data.weatherDescription: Get current weather conditions and forecasts for major cities across the Philippines. Plan your day with accurate temperature readings and weather alerts.
data.forexDescription: Track foreign exchange rates from Bangko Sentral ng Pilipinas (BSP). Convert currencies and view historical rate trends for major world currencies.

promotion.philsysDescription: Register for your Philippine Identification System (PhilSys) ID card today. The national ID serves as a single government-issued identification document for all citizens.

government.title: Local Government of the City of Dagupan
government.description: Learn about the key offices, councils, and local units that make up the City Government of Dagupan.
government.executiveDescription: Led by the Mayor, responsible for implementing city policies, programs, and ordinances.
government.legislativeDescription: Composed of the Sangguniang Panlungsod, responsible for making local laws.
government.barangaysDescription: Local government units within the city, led by elected officials who manage community-level services and programs.
government.departmentsDescription: City departments and agencies responsible for specific areas of governance.
government.electedofficialsDescription: The elected leadership of the Executive and Legislative branches, responsible for policy implementation and law-making.
government.directoryDescription: Find contact information for government officials, agencies, and offices at national and local levels.

disclaimer.short: {{portal}} is an independent, community-led project. It is not the official website of the City Government of {{lgu}}.
disclaimer.noticeBody: {{portal}} is built and maintained by volunteers. It is not the official website of the City Government of {{lgu}}, and it is not affiliated with or endorsed by any government agency.
disclaimer.officialSiteLabel: Visit the official {{lgu}} City Government website

emptyState.title: Not yet available
emptyState.body: Verified {{lgu}} information has not been added yet. This section is part of the portal's structure and will be filled once records are sourced from the City Government of {{lgu}} and verified.

civic.notVerifiedHint: Better Dagupan has not found an authoritative source for this detail yet. It is not a statement that the information does not exist.

barangays.officialsNotVerifiedWhy: The only city-government roster found covers the 2018–2020 term, so publishing it would present former officials as current ones. Names will be added once a current source is verified.
